authMethods.name: Sign in with xAI
authMethods.description: Opens the xAI sign-in page ($BROWSER, and a _wizard/auth_url notification) and waits for its redirect to 127.0.0.1.

authMethods.name: Sign in with ChatGPT
authMethods.description: Opens the ChatGPT sign-in page ($BROWSER, and a _wizard/auth_url notification) and waits for its redirect to localhost.

authMethods.name: API key
